data.name: Meme Wars
data.detailed_description:
Skill-based 1v1 arena fighter where iconic internet memes clash.

Dash, block, and combo through fast 3-minute duels. If no one falls, Sudden Death drains both life-bars—last one standing wins. Climb the ladder in ranked online PvP, or sharpen up in offline bot matches.

Pick your meme. Pick a fight.
Iconic, instantly recognizable fighters—each with a universal control scheme plus unique Special, Ultimate, and Passive abilities. Movement is responsive, matches are quick, and every decision spends Stamina or Mana—manage your bars or get punished.

Camera that fits the fight.
Swap between Free and Lock-On camera modes for optimal spacing, dodges, and pressure.

Key Features

  • 1v1 Ranked Duels: quick queue, skill-based progression, ELO-style leagues.

  • 3-Minute Rounds + Sudden Death: constant pressure, zero downtime.

  • Depth without bloat: dash cancels, blocks that drain stamina, timing-based combos.

  • Networking: Deterministic Rollback Net-code to ensure matches run smoothly and latency free. 

  • Status Effects: inflict and build effects like Burn, Stun, Wet, Poison, Sticky, Blood Loss, Crit, and Stance Breaker to tilt the fight.

  • Collect & Master Fighters: unlock characters, level them up, and refine your main.

  • Offline Bot Mode: practice routes and matchup knowledge anytime.

A taste of the roster
Doge • Crying Cat • The Biggest Bird… and more community-favorite memes, each animated with their own style and absurdity.

Designed for fast reads & big moments
Clean HUD with Health / Stamina / Mana, crunchy hit reactions, readable status icons, and cinematic Ultimate's that still respect counter-play.
